SAW (formerly stylized as sAw) is a Portuguese esports organization. It initially started as an organization-less team created in early 2020 by arki, JUST, MUTiRiS, rmn, stadodo, AIm, and Torres following the core's release from Giants Gaming.

  • January 1st - sAw announce their roster consisting of arki, JUST, MUTiRiS, rmn, stadodo, AIm as coach, and Torres as the team's analyst. [1]
  • February 14th - SAW part ways with AIm. [2]
  • February 17th - SAW part ways with Torres. [3]
  • March 4th - SAW re-sign AIm. [4]
  • September 6th - SAW bench arki and acquire story from For The Win Esports. [5]
  • November 1st - SAW bench story and reinstate arki to the starting lineup. [6]
  • December 20th - SAW part ways with AIm. [7]
  • January 4th - SAW release story and promote vts to the main team to assume the coaching role. [8]
  • January 22nd - SAW sign NABOWOW as analyst and assistant coach. [9]
  • June 25th - SAW bench stadodo, arki, and vts. [10]
  • July 1st - SAW and For The Win Esports exchange stadodo and vts for ewjerkz and story. Additionally, arki is moved to a coaching position. [11][12]
  • April 10th - SAW part ways with arki while NABOWOW takes over as interim coach. [13]
  • April 13th - SAW bench JUST. [14]
  • April 14th - SAW acquire arrozdoce from For The Win Esports. [15]
  • June 29th - SAW promote NABOWOW to act as the team's coach on a permanent basis. [16]
  • July 5th - JUST is acquired by Movistar Riders. [17]
  • November 2nd - SAW bench MUTiRiS by mutual agreement and add aragornN as a stand-in. [18]
  • November 15th - SAW part ways with aragornN and reinstate MUTiRiS to the starting lineup. [19]
  • January 10th - SAW sign SYDOX as an analyst. [20]
  • May 2nd - SAW part ways with NABOWOW. [21]
  • July 12th - SAW sign BERRY as their new coach. [22]
  • October 9th - SAW bench arrozdoce and acquire Ag1l from Rhyno Esports as his replacement. [23][24]
  • October 10th - SAW part ways with BERRY. [25]
  • October 28th - SAW sign Golden as their new coach. [26]
  • December 4th - SAW bench ewjerkz and acquire shr from GTZ.ESPORTS as his replacement. [27][28]
  • December 16th - story signs a contract extension with SAW, keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2027. [29]
  • December 18th - SAW release arrozdoce. [30]
  • December 19th - Golden signs a contract extension with SAW, keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2025. [31]
  • January 3rd - SAW release ewjerkz. [32]
  • February 22nd - SAW bench rmn and shr and acquire AZUWU and cej0t from Endpoint as their replacements. [33]
  • June 2nd - SAW bench Golden and part ways with AZUWU and cej0t. [34]
  • June 18th - SAW promote SYDOX from analyst to coach and acquire krazy and aragornN from Rhyno Esports to complete their lineup. [35]
  • June 30th - shr is acquired by an undisclosed organization, later revealed to be Imperial Esports. [36]
  • September 15th - SAW transition rmn into a streamer role within the organization. [37]
  • September 30th - SAW part ways with Golden following the expiration of his contract. [38]
  • October 13th - SAW promote mowzassa to a head coach position and move SYDOX back to an analyst role. [39]
  • January 3rd - SAW announce the sale of their roster: MUTiRiS, krazy and aragornN are acquired by BC.Game Esports, while story and Ag1l are acquired by undisclosed organizations, later revealed to be FlyQuest and 100 Thieves, respectively. [40][41][42]
  • January 5th - SAW acquire tuxa, m0retz, jERK0z, and blaze from EXSAD Gaming. [43]
  • January 30th - SAW sign Jayy2s. [44]
  • April 23rd - SAW part ways with blaze. [45]
  • June 16th - SAW sign snowiee to complete their lineup. [46]
  • June 23rd - SAW part ways with m0retz and add M1KA as a stand-in. [47]
  • July 3rd - SAW demote their roster to the academy team, sign ewjerkz and NOPEEj, acquire MUTiRiS and krazy from BC.Game Esports, and story from FlyQuest. [48]
